screen.notifications_tip: Fire notifications of every flavour. Useful to verify level colours, stacking, auto-dismiss timings, and system-tray routing.
screen.events_tip: Exercise the cross-wapp event bus and host → wapp triggers. Each received event is surfaced as an in-app notification so you can see the pipeline working end-to-end.
screen.widgets_tip: Call widgets declared by other wapps. The host's WidgetBroker looks up providers from the installed wapps' manifest.json provides.widgets array, spins up a headless engine for the selected provider, and delivers the response back here. Each response arrives as an in-app notification.
group.levels_tip: One button per level. Title-only, in-app scope.
group.stacking_tip: Fire multiple notifications in a burst to see them stack in the overlay.
group.local_pubsub_tip: Subscribe to a topic, publish to it, and see the event come back as a notification.
group.host_triggers_tip: Subscribe to the system.* topics that the host republishes from its own EventBus. Useful for reacting to wapp lifecycle or error events from inside a wapp.
group.demo_provider_tip: widget_demo provides both text.greet and text.shout from a single wapp — demonstrating that one wapp can provide multiple widgets.
group.error_paths_tip: Make sure error flows also surface cleanly.
action.notify_error_tip: Fires a title-only error-level notification. 6-second auto-dismiss.
action.notify_body_tip: Info-level notification with a body paragraph.
action.notify_error_body_tip: Error-level notification with a body paragraph.
action.notify_system_tip: Skips the in-app overlay, goes straight to notify-send / osascript.
action.notify_both_tip: Shown both in the overlay and in the OS notification area.
action.notify_stack_tip: Emits 5 notifications of mixed levels as fast as possible. The in-app overlay should show them stacked, newer ones below older ones.
action.event_pub_hello_tip: hal_event_publish(test.hello, greetings). Subscribe first or nothing receives it.
action.event_echo_tip: Subscribes to test.echo, publishes to it, and drains the result. Should produce one notification in under 500ms.
action.event_sub_wapp_loaded_tip: Fires whenever any wapp finishes its module_init. Open another wapp from the launcher to see it.
action.event_sub_wapp_unloaded_tip: Fires when a wapp page is disposed.
action.event_sub_error_tip: Fires whenever an ErrorEvent is published on the host EventBus.
action.widget_call_greet_tip: Sends a widget.request for text.greet. Expects {greeting: ...}.
action.widget_call_shout_tip: Sends a widget.request for text.shout. Expects {loud: ...}.
action.widget_call_missing_tip: Calls widget id "does.not.exist". Should surface an error notification.
